title: Narra 4.1.33 — smoother discovery and playback
message: Install 4.1.33 over Narra 4.1.32 to keep your library, downloads, and settings. Anime details and Library layouts are cleaner, and free Asian Drama playback now includes ads while Premium stays ad-free.
changelog: Update over 4.1.32 without uninstalling to keep your local library, downloads, and settings.
Anime detail and episode layouts are cleaner, with more room for metadata and reviews.
Library and navigation layouts are more compact and easier to use.
Free Asian Drama playback now uses the normal ad flow; Premium remains ad-free.
Account checks better tolerate a temporary Firebase token refresh failure.
